newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Roselle, N.J..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Roselle, N.J..

text.p: SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Chief Financial Officer of the Borough of Roselle in the County of Union, New Jersey (the Borough''), at the Municipal Building, 210 Chestnut Street, Roselle, New Jersey, on

until 11:00 A.M., at which time they will be publicly opened and announced, for the purchase of the Borough's general obligation bonds dated February 15, 1997 and due on February 15, according to the following schedule (collectively, the Bonds'') in accordance with the Notice of Sale dated February 13, 1997 (the Notice of Sale''):
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount
Individual purchases of beneficial ownership interests in the Bonds will be made in book-entry form (without

certificates) in the denomination of $5,000 each or any integral multiple thereof, except that such minimum amount of the last maturing Bonds in excess of the largest principal amount thereof equaling a multiple of $5,000 will be in the denominations of $1,000, or any integral multiple thereof, as may be necessary to comply with the proposal for Bonds of the successful bidder to accept less than the full amount of the Bonds offered for sale, in accordance with the Notice of Sale.

The Bonds will bear interest at a single rate of interest in a multiple of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1% per annum specified by the successful bidder payable on August 15, 1997 and semiannually thereafter on February 15 and August 15 in each year until maturity. The Bonds will be sold to the bidder specifying the lowest rate of interest in accordance with the terms of the Notice of Sale.
The Bonds will be designated as
obligations'' for purposes of Section 265(b)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended.

Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, the Notice of Sale, the Proposal for Bonds and the form of the legal opinion of Crummy, Del Deo, Dolan, Griffinger & Vecchione, a Professional Corporation, Newark, New Jersey, bond counsel to the Borough, may be obtained from the Chief Financial Officer of the Borough at the Municipal Building, 210
